purpose: Single entry authority: closed-bar cognition with volume classes → S4.1 commands → LIVE1B books. LIVE1A journal is never an entry source.

invariants.must: production entry_source is s41_command_bus; LIVE1B S41CommandConsumer is constructed; journal poll is observe-only
when entry_source=s41_command_bus, CONTEXT_START/FLIP must not open a LIVE1B position
PROVISIONAL_INTRABAR resolve_timeframe_state is not actionable for S4.1
untagged lifecycle parquet is M15-only; H1 without own rows is NO_LIFECYCLE_ROW, not M15 direction

journal CONTEXT_START is one-shot per episode; S4.1 OPEN follows current parquet direction and may re-enter after TP/SL while that episode remains directional; CONTEXT_END still blocks via ended_episodes; FLIP to opposite episode still allowed

S4.1 desired position equals closed-bar parquet direction the chart paints; restated opposite on the same source_bar_close is followed; path-density anti-saw vetoes flat OPEN and ATOMIC_FLIP OPEN when the closed-bar window is a saw; CLOSE/SL/TP/HOLD are not gated
LONG open + SHORT_CONTEXT ACTIVE in one manager cycle emits CLOSE and opposite OPEN (or intent FLIP), not CLOSE alone
ENTRY_BLOCKED_EXECUTION_MARKET_NOT_READY and missing local BBO must not consume the command_id
S4.1 actionable context is closed-bar parquet lineage, not LIVE1A volume_class=unknown
entry_source=s41_command_bus paints parquet lifecycle bands, not LIVE1A journal
hybrid cutover and VPS bootstrap write entry_source=s41_command_bus and do not say S4.1 is not entry authority

when entry_source=s41_command_bus, load_sources reads market_context_lifecycle_memory.parquet not LIVE1A journal; OBSERVE/NO_ACTIVE keeps the living LONG/SHORT so S4.1 HOLD not CLOSE; flatten only on opposite ACTIVE context
open LONG holds through OBSERVE and resumes if LONG returns; open SHORT holds through OBSERVE and resumes if SHORT returns; CLOSE only when painted context becomes the opposite ACTIVE
lifecycle never paints LONG→SHORT or SHORT→LONG; confirmed opposite ACTIVE ends living thesis to OBSERVE; opposite activates only from OBSERVE on a later bar

flat-slot OPEN requires raw_context_status ACTIVE on the resolved lifecycle row; DEVELOPING/OBSERVE while lifecycle ACTIVE is NO_ACTION RAW_STATUS_NOT_CONFIRMED; missing/UNKNOWN fail-open; ATOMIC_FLIP_OPEN is not gated by raw status; CLOSE/HOLD unchanged
flat OPEN and context-flip CLOSE require process_strength >= 0.5 * TF_WEIGHT; missing strength fail-open; SL/TP CLOSE is not gated; opposite accept kills only when its hit >= living strength
